record.end_precision: unknown; interim opening is not final endpoint
record.scope: Kalpaki road approach serving two named international customs posts; exact barrier location unbound
record.crossings: Approach to Kakavia / Kakavija and Mertzani / Tre Urat
record.direction: Road approach; exact crossing-direction inventory absent
record.exceptions: Buses and vulnerable groups allowed; an intervening one-hour opening is explicit.

record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified by this research packet.
record.relationship: No matching February 20 2024 Kalpaki approach blockade in current/pending union. REC50-R03-003 concerns a May 2018 customs strike at Kakavija/Kapshtica; NP-COV-EUR-009 concerns July 2026 customs-service action. Different dates, locations and actors.
record.status_observation: Historical dated evidence only; an unknown endpoint is not evidence of present open or closed status.
record.current_timing: Intermittent regime envelope; total closed days unknown
record.current_corrections: ERT describes an intermittent blockade of the Kalpaki approach road to Kakavia and Mertzani, not closure of the customs facilities. A one-hour opening until 14:00 interrupts continuity. Buses and vulnerable groups could pass. Planned 23:00 finish and planned bypass blockage are not completed events.
